structuralGaps.title: Print-candidate backlog is much larger than the verified private corpus
structuralGaps.evidence: 935 OCR-derived print leads, including 557 high-priority leads, are not yet selected, transcribed, or compared against the country chronologies.
structuralGaps.recommendedAction: Triage high-priority leads by country and theme before treating the memcon/telcon chapters as complete.

structuralGaps.title: Several countries have thin or absent private-record coverage
structuralGaps.evidence: Bolivia: 4 private records, 47 high-priority leads; Chile: 3 private records, 32 high-priority leads; Suriname: 0 private records, 2 high-priority leads; Paraguay: 2 private records, 19 high-priority leads; Peru: 4 private records, 29 high-priority leads; Guyana: 1 private records, 25 high-priority leads; Ecuador: 3 private records, 11 high-priority leads
structuralGaps.recommendedAction: Prioritize these chapters for non-presidential NSC files, State Department records, and agency records.

structuralGaps.title: Public-private chronology mismatches remain unresolved
structuralGaps.evidence: Bolivia: 47 public statements vs. 4 private records; Chile: 41 public statements vs. 3 private records; Paraguay: 23 public statements vs. 2 private records; Peru: 66 public statements vs. 4 private records; Ecuador: 27 public statements vs. 3 private records
structuralGaps.recommendedAction: For mismatch countries, map public statements to surrounding private memoranda, cables, briefing papers, and policy papers.

structuralGaps.title: Current site sources are NSC/Bush Library-heavy
structuralGaps.evidence: The site now covers Bush Library memcons/telcons, Scowcroft extracts, selected NSC Latin America files, Deal files, and Public Papers. It does not yet represent State central files, embassy cables, Treasury, Defense, CIA, DEA, or congressional notification files.
structuralGaps.recommendedAction: Use this site as a presidential/NSC starting point, not as the full FRUS evidentiary universe.

structuralGaps.title: Partial releases require replacement or annotation checks
structuralGaps.evidence: 4 private record(s) are marked Partial: Argentina 1992-04-07; Bolivia 1990-05-08; Chile 1992-05-13; Colombia 1989-11-27.
structuralGaps.recommendedAction: Check whether less-redacted versions exist in parallel files or later releases.

structuralGaps.title: OCR-derived leads are not document-level certainty
structuralGaps.evidence: Withdrawal-sheet rows and page OCR identify likely documents but can contain OCR noise, truncated titles, and page-start uncertainty.
structuralGaps.recommendedAction: Confirm page images and source folders before final document selection or citation.
